title: Prove retained launch records in Node Vitest

intentCoverage.report:
Verdict: Caught.

Story and revision: SEED-413#prove-kept-launch-records-on-vitest (plan 851, slice 4), revision 6fd3c41ec7428066c5feeab7f251a7b79fdc36b4. Promise: "Given a Claude and a Codex record with the same native ID ... A Done or Delete naming Codex changes only the Codex record and calls Claude for nothing. One that names no host addresses Claude."

Fault (revised slightly from the suggestion, narrower): in dashboard/server/sessionAdmission.ts `namedSession` (the Done/Delete admission that `admittedDone` uses), the session reference was built with the host ignored:
  - const session = { sessionId: parsed.data.session, host: parsed.data.host };
  + const session = { sessionId: parsed.data.session, host: "claude" as const };
So any Done naming an equal ID resolves to the first (Claude) record. I faulted admission rather than `keptSession`/`sessionRecord` in launchRecordStore.ts because those are shared by deletion, terminal admission and other lookups; the admission-local fault targets exactly the relocated/refactored path the risk named. No fixture or assertion changed.

Maintained check examined: dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-host-identity.spec.ts:126 (the single case), via the `markDone` helper that calls production `admittedDone` then `NativeDoneMarks.markDone`.

Runs (scratch detached worktree under /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/0eea4361/tmp, npm ci, Node 24.21.0; command: env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_BACKEND_SPLIT -u FORCE_COLOR -u NO_COLOR npm run test:dashboard:backend -- 'launches/agent-launch-host-identity\.spec\.ts$' --workers=1):
- Baseline: 1 passed (case :126 ran, 855 ms), pre-probe git status clean.
- Faulted: 1 failed at spec line 161, `expect(otherMarked).toMatchObject({...other, doneProblem: stringContaining("Saved native endpoint is missing")})`.
- Wrong behavior independently observed in the returned Done record (the product's own output, shown in the diff): the Codex-named Done returned and marked the Claude record (request.host and session.host "claude") with doneProblem "Local done mark retained. Claude Code rename failed: The session is no longer running, so it was not renamed." — i.e. it changed the Claude record and invoked a Claude native rename, the exact behavior the promise forbids. Reach is confirmed: the assertion exercised the Codex-named Done path.
- Restored: original file copied back, `git diff`/`git status --porcelain` empty (only ignored test-results), same command 1 passed (185 ms). Scratch worktree then removed; live checkout untouched; no stash used.

Claim bound: the catch covers a Codex-named Done resolving to Claude through admission. Codex-named Delete (via deleteRecord, which uses keptSession directly, not namedSession) and the hostless-Done branch were not separately faulted in this probe.

Next proof action: none required for this path; the maintained assertion at spec line 161 catches it. Optionally probe the Delete path separately if that half of the promise is considered at risk.

Prior disposition: none matched; no new repair decision arises.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured, Vitest-reported Duration — baseline 2.66 s, faulted 0.677 s, restored 0.689 s (per-run wall of the runner, excluding npm ci).
- Human effort: unavailable — no human participated or measured time.
- Agent effort: unavailable — no separately supported token or time measure available to this agent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 61772 ms (measured), from 1795701060000 to 1795701121772 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 6fd3c41ec7428066c5feeab7f251a7b79fdc36b4, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
